title: Glitch in the Blueprint | ECHO//100 Episode 93
description:
Kavi discovers his reality is built on a foundation of his own future secrets. The timeline fractures when he attempts to rewrite his own history. Episode 93 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an original work of fiction created with the assistance of AI.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The floor beneath Kavi’s feet dissolves into a blinding, endless grid of cascading binary code.
scenes.caption: Reality turns to code
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in red hoodie and glasses standing on a glowing digital floor of binary code, vertical cinematic perspective.

scenes.text: Every step Kavi takes triggers a ripple of static, exposing the raw source code of home.
scenes.caption: Walking on memory
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi walking through a digital void where the walls of his living room are becoming wireframe grids.

scenes.text: Byte hovers nearby, his cyan face flickering as he scans a pocket of jagged, corrupted data.
scenes.caption: Byte detects corruption
scenes.image_prompt: Byte the floating white robot with orange antenna scanning a glowing purple tear in the digital floor.

scenes.text: Kavi touches the corruption, realizing it’s a deliberate save-point planted by his own future self.
scenes.caption: A message from future
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi's hand reaching toward a shimmering purple data node inside the digital floor.

scenes.text: He recognizes the syntax: these commands are the blueprint for the life he currently inhabits.
scenes.caption: Decoding his existence
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at floating holographic text projections in his red hoodie and backpack.

scenes.text: Kavi deletes the corruption, but the environment shudders, forcing a forbidden red doorway into view.
scenes.caption: The door returns
scenes.image_prompt: A glowing red door manifesting in the center of the wireframe living room, Kavi looking shocked.

scenes.text: Mira appears as blue holographic text, warning that the door is now bonded to his biology.
scenes.caption: Mira's dire warning
scenes.image_prompt: Mira in her teal coat manifested as blue light, pointing toward the pulsating red door.

scenes.text: The red door pulses, its rhythmic glow perfectly synchronized with the beating of Kavi’s heart.
scenes.caption: Heartbeat synchronization
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi's chest glowing red in sync with the distant red door, intense lighting.
